name: compartment_toy_v1
description: Phase 5 MVP: literature-parameterized Neftel-inspired four-compartment logistic growth toy model with baseline vs TMZ vs TMZ+FUS scenarios. Research prototype only - not a biophysical digital twin and not clinically validated.

scenarios.label: Baseline growth (no cytotoxic pressure)
notes: Baseline isolates growth and transition dynamics without kill pressure.

scenarios.label: Toy TMZ pressure
notes: TMZ kill rate is a scenario knob inspired by alkylating-agent literature themes, not a calibrated effect size.

scenarios.label: Toy TMZ + FUS delivery multiplier
notes: FUS is modelled only as a delivery multiplier on effective kill pressure (research toy), not as validated BBB opening pharmacology.

assumptions: Compartment labels follow a Neftel-inspired MES/NPC/OPC/AC vocabulary for research alignment only.
Growth is discrete-time logistic with a shared carrying capacity.
Transition rates are symmetric toy leakage, not inferred from single-cell data in this MVP.
Kill and delivery multipliers are explicit scenario knobs with literature-themed anchors, not patient-ready predictions.
Phase 6 may rank these toy scenarios for research comparison only; it is not CDS and not a prescription engine.

literature_anchors.note: Neftel et al. cell-state framework cited as vocabulary inspiration only (not used to fit rates here).
Sample graph fixture includes MGMT-to-TMZ response PREDICTS relation as an evidence-tier example.
Sample graph fixture includes FUS ENHANCES_DELIVERY_OF temozolomide as a delivery-modifier example.
